facts.fact: The Data Protection Authority issued an official notice and said it had begun accepting registration applications from controllers and processors, so it was acting by 2 June 2026.

The Authority's notice requires registration under Article 32 of the Data Protection Act, applied to all entities that collect, store, process or share personal data in Somalia (date is the article's published date).

The Authority began accepting registration applications and said it will issue certificates only to those meeting the conditions; no count of registrations or decision is given (date is the article's published date).
The Authority opened registration of controllers and processors under Article 32, reported on 2 June 2026.
